capabilities.description: Managers ask natural-language questions grounded in uploaded documents (BOMs, work instructions, quality procedures, supplier price lists); the system retrieves the relevant passages across both plants and answers from them, citing the source.
Tracks supplier costs, parts pricing and invoices in MAD, pulls costing and invoicing data from SAP ERP, and holds the money model the reasoning layer reasons over.
Watches supplier cost and parts price movements (on POs and invoices) against manager-set thresholds in MAD, and raises alerts with an emailed Outlook notification and a dashboard entry.
Detects when a work instruction or quality procedure is revised in Microsoft 365 or on upload, and nudges affected managers by Outlook email and on the dashboard.
Ingests BOMs, work instructions, quality procedures and supplier price lists from OneDrive/Outlook and from direct file uploads, with provenance recorded so answers stay grounded.
A single manager dashboard showing cost and parts-price movements in MAD, recent document revisions, and open alerts across both plants.
Simple manager-only log-in and roles, covering a handful to a few dozen managers across the two Moroccan plants.
Sap Odata Connector capability (reused from the block store)

summary: A pilot platform for manager-level users at two electric-car plants in Morocco, each running five production lines on 12-hour shifts around the clock. It puts a reasoning layer over money and documents: it tracks supplier costs, parts pricing and invoicing in MAD, plugs into SAP ERP for costing/invoicing data, and answers managers' questions grounded in documents they upload (BOMs, work instructions, quality procedures, supplier price lists) sourced from Microsoft 365 (OneDrive/Outlook) and uplo
